Live, 3 November 2026: share of one CPU core over 45 s, the worker stopped on a permission prompt Firstmate had already reported.

g.text: After: the fork's wait tells us

svg.text: grey: the rest of the fleet's own load on the server, the same in every window

g.text: And the prompt still wakes Firstmate at once: 41 ms from the prompt appearing in T3 to Firstmate's wait returning,
naming the command (before: up to about a second, from the once-a-second re-read).
